title: Evaluation of Wide Corneal Epithelial Remodeling after Small Incision Lenticule Extraction (SMILE) with Wide-Field Optical Coherence Tomography

license.statement: Creative Commons Attribution License, version not stated (article <license>)

indication: myopia or myopic astigmatism; 64 eyes of 64 patients

groups.description: Standard SMILE (VisuMax 500 kHz, 110 um cap, 6.0-6.9 mm optical zone), one eye per patient

exclusions.reason: prints the preoperative mean of tab1!R5C2 with a figure dash (U+2012) that the frozen number parser does not read; tab1!R5C2 (same 64 eyes) is cited instead

exclusions.what: Proportion within ±0.50 D of the intended correction (Results)

notes: Method manifest: Methods state manifest refraction at 1, 3 and 6 months; preoperatively both manifest and cycloplegic refraction were measured and the tables do not say which preoperative SE is shown.
Target unstated: the Results refer to the intended correction without stating it.
Epithelial thickness, visual acuity, sphere and cylinder are tabulated but not extracted.

series.notes: mean ± SD (range rows not used); refraction not measured at 1 day and 1 week
